data.name: Hrithvik
data.gender_notes: Hrithvik is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root 'hrith' meaning 'that which is stable' and 'vik' meaning 'leap' or 'jump'. This name symbolizes the divine leap of Lord Vishnu to preserve the universe from destruction. The name Hrithvik carries the meaning “Lord Vishnu's Leap” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hrithvik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord vishnu's leap and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Emblem of divine protection and preservation.
data.etymology: Hrithvik belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord Vishnu's Leap.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hrithvik total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
